title: Freeze on Game Start
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in 4.6.1 stable - Reproducible in 4.7-dev2 - Reproducible in git main (v4.7.dev.custom_build.65e73b3a5) ### System information Arch Linux, KDE, Wayland, Godot 4.6.1 stable - 4.7-dev, Forward+, Radeon RX 6800XT (AMD) ### Issue description Recently in Godot 4.6.1 I started having freezes / crashes whenever I try to run my game. The freeze doesn't leave a trace in the Godot Editor debugger. I have to force kill the game process with OS tools to be able to carry on. I have built Godot from git main source and run in GDB, the freeze is reproducible and after I manually interrupted the process and called `bt` I got this: ``` Framework-REPO on  devel-unfa [$] ❯ gdb "../Godot/godot-repo/bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64" [...] Detaching after vfork from child process 10012] [New Thread 0x7ffff6dff6c0 (LWP 10014)] [New Thread 0x7ffff65fe6c0 (LWP 10015)] [New Thread 0x7ffff5dfd6c0 (LWP 10016)] [New Thread 0x7ffff55fc6c0 (LWP 10017)] [New Thread 0x7ffff4dfb6c0 (LWP 10018)] [New Thread 0x7fffe7fff6c0 (LWP 10019)] [New Thread 0x7fffe77fe6c0 (LWP 10020)] [New Thread 0x7fffe6ffd6c0 (LWP 10021)] [New Thread 0x7fffe67fc6c0 (LWP 10022)] [New Thread 0x7fffe5ffb6c0 (LWP 10023)] [New Thread 0x7fffe57fa6c0 (LWP 10024)] [New Thread 0x7fffe4ff96c0 (LWP 10025)] [New Thread 0x7fffc7fff6c0 (LWP 10026)] [New Thread 0x7fffc77fe6c0 (LWP 10027)] [New Thread 0x7fffc6ffd6c0 (LWP 10028)] [New Thread 0x7fffc67fc6c0 (LWP 10029)] [New Thread 0x7fffc5ffb6c0 (LWP 10030)] [New Thread 0x7fffc57fa6c0 (LWP 10031)] [New Thread 0x7fffc4ff96c0 (LWP 10032)] [New Thread 0x7fffa3fff6c0 (LWP 10033)] [New Thread 0x7fff9bfff6c0 (LWP 10034)] [New Thread 0x7fffa37fe6c0 (LWP 10035)] [New Thread 0x7fffa2ffd6c0 (LWP 10036)] [New Thread 0x7fffa27fc6c0 (LWP 10037)] [New Thread 0x7fffa1ffb6c0 (LWP 10038)] Godot Engine v4.7.dev.custom_build.65e73b3a5 (2026-03-21 11:05:29 UTC) - Clone Liblast Framework repository from Codeberg: git clone https://codeberg.org/Liblast/liblast-framework.git cd liblast-framework # 2. You could switch to branch `devel-unfa`, but it's probably better to checkout an exact commit that I have tested this with git checkout cf798c480f # 3. Ensure Git LFS is installed and asset files are properly pulled git lfs install git lfs pull # 4. Import project godot --headless -e --import . # 5. Run project godot . ``` You should see this window: And this console output: ``` liblast-framework on  devel-unfa [!?] took 3s ❯ godot . As you probably have guessed - I'd like to find the reason why. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) I am afraid I can't make one, the reproduction steps provide instructions to reproduce the issue in an existing project.
